newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria bought 100,000 tonnes French wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Algeria bought 100,000 tonnes French wheat - trade.

text.p: Algeria has bought 100,000 tonnes of French soft wheat at a delivered price of $188 per tonne for November and December arrival, industry sources said on Thursday.
The deal, concluded on Wednesday, valued the wheat at some $160 per tonne fob, excluding all financing and other costs, they said. The wheat was sold with Coface export credits.

Algeria tendered on Monday for 50,000 tonnes to be delivered in the second half of November and 50,000 tonnes in the first half of December. Traders were invited to submit offers for both French and U.S. wheat.
